description: List allocation proposals for an ORCID researcher, or supply put_code from a summary record to retrieve its actual resource items. Summary is the default view and includes every proposal host, identifiers, access period, and source provenance; hostOrganization remains the first proposal host. Detail adds item names, types, all operators, identifiers, and URLs, paged by item_offset and item_limit (both require put_code); continue at nextItemOffset with the same put_code. Most researchers have no entries; allocation systems such as ACCESS deposit these records.

item_limit.description: Items per detail page. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 100 and says so. Requires put_code.

item_offset.description: Detail item offset. Default 0; requires put_code.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

put_code.description: Proposal put-code from summary mode; selects the full allocation detail.

name: orcid_get_research_resources

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `detail_required`: Item paging arguments are supplied without put_code. `resource_not_found`: The selected allocation detail does not exist or is not public. `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

itemLimitNotice.description: Notice when the requested item limit is reduced to the effective maximum of 100.

notice.description: Note when no research resources are found — this section is sparsely populated across ORCID profiles — or when a deprecated iD was served from its primary iD.

putCode.description: Selected proposal put-code in detail mode.

resourceCount.description: Total number of research resources returned.

resources.description: Research resources associated with this ORCID iD.

endDate.description: Access or allocation end date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

externalIds.description: External identifiers for the resource (often a portal URI).

items.description: External identifier for the research resource.

relationship.description: Relationship to the resource (self or part-of).

url.description: Resolver URL for this identifier, if available.

hostOrganization.description: Organization that hosts or manages the resource.

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated organization ID (e.g. ROR or GRID identifier).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of the disambiguation ID (e.g. ROR, GRID, RINGGOLD).

items.description: Selected page of allocation items in detail mode.
External identifier for the research resource.

relationship.description: Relationship to the resource (self or part-of).

url.description: Resolver URL for this identifier, if available.

hosts.description: All item operators in upstream order; missing host details remain unknown.

items.description: Hosting organization for the research resource.

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated organization ID (e.g. ROR or GRID identifier).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of the disambiguation ID (e.g. ROR, GRID, RINGGOLD).

itemsTruncated.description: Whether more allocation items remain after this page.

nextItemOffset.description: First omitted item offset; absent when no items remain.

proposalHosts.description: All proposal hosts in upstream order; separate from item operators.

items.description: Hosting organization for the research resource.

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated organization ID (e.g. ROR or GRID identifier).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of the disambiguation ID (e.g. ROR, GRID, RINGGOLD).

putCode.description: Put-code of this research resource record.

sources.description: The party that added this resource to the ORCID record — usually the allocation system that granted it. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the record's ORCID iD (orcidId); false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

startDate.description: Access or allocation start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

url.description: URL for the resource or allocation record.

truncated.description: Detail-page indicator: true exactly when the selected resource has allocation items remaining after this page; mirrors itemsTruncated. Absent in summary mode.

view.description: Summary list or selected allocation detail.
